_note: HEDIS measure → codes mapping. Demo data curated by AXCEL from public HEDIS technical specifications. Replace with ProEd's NCQA-licensed value sets for production.
_source_swap: For production, ingest NCQA's official HEDIS value sets XLSX (annual subscription). Update this file and re-run npm run seed:hedis.
_format: Each measure has a code (short abbrev), full name, and lists of ICD-10/HCPCS/CPT codes that count toward the measure numerator or denominator.

measures.name: Comprehensive Diabetes Care
measures.description: Diabetes management including HbA1c testing, eye exam, kidney health monitoring, and BP control for members with diabetes.

measures.name: Controlling High Blood Pressure
measures.description: Members with hypertension whose blood pressure was adequately controlled (<140/90 mmHg).

measures.name: Breast Cancer Screening
measures.description: Women 50–74 who had a mammogram to screen for breast cancer.

measures.name: Cervical Cancer Screening
measures.description: Women 21–64 screened for cervical cancer via Pap smear or HPV co-test.

measures.name: Colorectal Cancer Screening
measures.description: Adults 45–75 screened for colorectal cancer via colonoscopy, sigmoidoscopy, FIT, or FOBT.

measures.name: Prenatal and Postpartum Care
measures.description: Deliveries that had a timely prenatal visit and a postpartum visit within recommended timeframes.

measures.name: Childhood Immunization Status
measures.description: Children who received recommended vaccines by their 2nd birthday (DTaP, IPV, MMR, HiB, HepB, VZV, PCV, HepA, RV, flu).

measures.name: Avoidance of Antibiotic Treatment for Acute Bronchitis
measures.description: Adults 18–64 with acute bronchitis who were NOT prescribed an antibiotic (lower is better).

measures.name: Medication Reconciliation Post-Discharge
measures.description: Discharges from inpatient stays where medication reconciliation was performed within 30 days.

measures.name: Transitions of Care
measures.description: Timely notification, medication reconciliation, follow-up visit, and patient engagement after inpatient discharge.

measures.name: Follow-up After Hospitalization for Mental Illness
measures.description: Discharges for mental health treatment with an outpatient follow-up visit within 7 and 30 days.

measures.name: Asthma Medication Ratio
measures.description: Members with persistent asthma whose asthma controller-to-total-medication ratio is 0.50 or higher.

measures.name: Statin Use in Persons with Diabetes
measures.description: Adults 40–75 with diabetes who received a statin therapy prescription.

measures.name: Adults' Access to Preventive/Ambulatory Health Services
measures.description: Adults with an ambulatory or preventive care visit during the measurement year.
